services.title: Tailored Executive Mobility
services.subtitle: Executive transport for demanding corporate routines — safety, comfort and logistics.

landing.title: The executive day, line by line.
landing.lead: Point-to-point, hours on demand or concierge — punctuality, safety and discretion, with fare agreed on WhatsApp.
landing.servicesTitle: Three ways to move without improvising
landing.servicesLead: Pick the format; the fare is closed with the driver on WhatsApp, with the same operational discipline.
landing.svcAirportBody: Direct trip with origin, destination and stops. Includes GRU, CGH and VCP when part of the itinerary.
landing.svcCorpBody: Chauffeur and vehicle reserved by the hour — flexible for meetings, roadshows and sequential trips.
landing.svcVipBody: Tailored one-off requests: shopping, errands, accompaniment and other services defined with the driver.
landing.fleetLead: High-end vehicles for comfort, presence and, when needed, armor.
landing.fleetCta: Tell us the trip profile — we match vehicle and chauffeur.
landing.coverageLead: São Paulo city, Greater SP and the three airports that move the region's corporate agenda.
landing.footerLead: Executive mobility with safety and discretion. São Paulo — SP.
landing.footerContactLead: Share the service and time — we agree the fare on WhatsApp.
landing.footerCopy: Executive mobility with safety and excellence.

admin.availabilityLead: Configure weekly windows or mark unavailable periods (blackout).
